description: Check whether a company can receive Peppol e-invoices: give a VAT number, company number (KBO/BCE, KvK, SIREN/SIRET), GLN or Peppol ID and it checks every relevant scheme (e.g. Belgian 0208 and 9925) in the live Peppol SML/SMP, lists supported document types and says which ID to send to. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

country.description: ISO country code hint for ambiguous numbers, e.g. 'BE' or 'FR'.

id.description: VAT number (BE0403170701), company number or Peppol ID (0208:0403170701).

name: lookup_peppol_participant
title: Check Peppol receivability
